decision.title: Retrieval And Reasoning Topology
decision.summary: Use deterministic workflow routing over graph-backed retrieval, with vector and lexical retrieval as bounded fallback tools.

domain_invariants: Every answer must include source span IDs.
Compliance-critical answers must include graph node IDs when graph traversal is used.
The query orchestrator must not mutate ingestion state.
Cross-context communication must happen through explicit interfaces or domain events.
The system must abstain when source-backed lineage cannot be established.

candidate_topologies.name: naive_vector_rag
candidate_topologies.fit: Good for self-contained document search, weak for multi-hop contract exposure analysis.
risks: Relationship-heavy facts can be flattened into unrelated chunks.
Lineage can degrade into loose similarity rather than explicit evidence.
Hard to prove why a cross-document dependency exists.

candidate_topologies.name: pure_agentic_search
candidate_topologies.fit: Useful for exploratory analyst research, weak as the primary compliance answer path.

candidate_topologies.name: workflow_routed_hybrid_graphrag
candidate_topologies.fit: Strong fit for relationship-heavy contract reasoning with deterministic execution and source-backed lineage.
risks: Requires explicit evaluation of extraction quality.

required_invariants: All generated answers must include source span IDs.
Graph traversal results must include graph node IDs.
Compliance-critical queries must run through deterministic workflow routing.
Agentic search is allowed only outside the primary compliance answer path.
Cross-context reads must go through explicit interfaces rather than direct database coupling.
allowed_agentic_use: ontology enrichment proposals pending human review
